items.detail:
The docket quotes the announcement as "Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS) improvement of up to 60% against IMERG, 30% for MRMS, and 10% against rain gauge measurements". I fetched https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/google-deepmind/introducing-weathernext-3/ on 2026-09-07 and the same sentence ends "...and 10% against rain gauge measurements for early lead times". The docket's own done-when line already requires every accuracy figure to name whoever measured it and against what; the lead-time condition belongs in that list, because a CRPS gain at early lead times is not a medium-range claim. Fix: carry the four words.

items.detail:
`verify-frontier-backfill-recheck.md` ("Domains: nothing to add") states that "both Astra posts describe a model acting 'without a person guiding each step'". Measured: the phrase appears only in `content/blog/openai-astra-critical-designation.md` (line 17). In `content/blog/openai-gpt-6-astra-system-card.md` the phrase is absent and the substring "agent" does not occur anywhere in the file at all (case-insensitive Grep, no matches), so nothing in that post supports the attribution. The conclusion the passage reaches — assign no `agents` domain, because `lib/domains.mjs` forbids inference — is unaffected and is if anything stronger. The fix is one word: name the single post that carries the phrase instead of "both Astra posts".
